$comment: Aqua carrying shadow. The only garden route to Umbra, which is what stops the cave being the sole supplier.
Ignis and Aer with no Terra between them — the pairing no mineral offers.

Umbra with nothing else in it, 80m down the quarry. It used to be the only clean Umbra in the game; Gloamroot, Gloomcap and Shade Spar now cover the weak, middling and strong levels earlier on, and this stays the rare one in between.
The Cinderveil Bomb's signature reagent. Every recipe needs one thing that points at it, or it is a recipe for something nobody can gather.

Umbra and nothing else, at the herb level. Umbra only ever came blended with Aer, or as one mineral 80m down; this is the early, weak, clean one. Slow in the ground, so patience is still the price of Umbra.
Umbra and nothing else, at the cave level. The cave is where darkness is grown on purpose, so this is its dark mushroom.
Umbra and nothing else, at the mineral level — the dense one for hitting a ratio exactly.
Aer and nothing else, at the herb level. Gale Thistle is close but not clean; nothing single-essence Aer existed below the rank-2 expedition.
Aer and nothing else, at the mineral level, 200m shallower than the two that were already there.
